r13_contract.comparisonModel: For ice classes IA and IA Super, the rudder (the rudder stock and the upper part of the rudder) shall be protected from direct contact with intact ice by an ice knife that extends below the LIWL, if practicable (or equivalent means).

test_cases.rationale: IA ship with practicable ice knife has a knife extending below the LIWL.
IA Super ship uses an equivalent rudder-protection means when the ice knife is not practicable.
IB ship is outside the IA/IA Super conditional obligation.
Applicable IA ship has no rudder-protection arrangement.
Ice knife does not extend below the LIWL.
Applicable ship has only a generic arrangement, not an ice knife or equivalent means.
Applicable ship is missing the iceKnifePracticable applicability state.

benchmark_policy: Source/R13-defined behavioral oracle created without inspecting generated SHACL.
